sources.title: cicada-ai/Jogg-Avatar-V2V · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jogg-Avatar V2V is an audio-driven video-to-video avatar model based on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. It preserves the source video's body, camera, and background motion while regenerating the face region to follow a driving audio track.
